title: Namnama 2 peanut (NSIC Pn 14): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Namnama 2 peanut: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Namnama 2 peanut is a peanut variety for Mindanao. 101 to 105 days to harvest, 1.4 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: Namnama 2 is a registered peanut variety, also sold or known as NSIC Pn 14. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2007 as NSIC 2007 Pn 14. DA CVIARC bred it. It takes 101 to 105 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.44 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 101 to 105 days from sowing to harvest.
**Yield:** 1.44 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** Mindanao, in both the wet and the dry season.

blocks.caption: Key facts of Namnama 2
rows: Both the wet and the dry season

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Namnama 2 peanut takes 101 to 105 days from sowing to harvest. That is about the average of the 26 peanut varieties with a day count, 101.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.44 t/ha trails the average of its group, 1.85. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 101 to 105 days.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit peanut fields most often: [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [thrips](/pests/thrips). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A hundred seeds weigh about 81.7 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed. The seed holds 25.31 percent crude protein.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** 1.11 t/ha dry season, 1.77 t/ha wet season.
**Fruit:** Big seeds, about 70 to 82 g per 100 seeds, about 69 percent shelling.
**Where:** Both seasons in Southern Mindanao and Ilocos, wet season in Regions 2, 3 and 4.
Resistant to rust and Cercospora leaf spot.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: a big seeded Cagayan Valley peanut that gave the heaviest seeds in a Nueva Vizcaya trial of four varieties. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Namnama 2 peanut

It is recommended for Mindanao in both the wet and the dry season. Mani needs loose, well drained soil to fill its pods. Pick a variety by seed size for your buyer, and one rated against rust and leaf spot for the wet season.

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is NSIC Pn 14 the same as Namnama 2?
items.a: Yes. NSIC Pn 14 is another name for Namnama 2, registered as NSIC 2007 Pn 14. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 101 to 105 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 1.44 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
It is recommended for Mindanao in both the wet and the dry season. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Namnama 2?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
